title: 環境計測学
subtitle: Environmental Analysis
keywords: Global environment 2.Environmental analyses 3.Environmental issues 4.Water quality measurements
educationalGoal: To fully understand environmental issues, such as pollution, that have multiple effects on the global environment, you will learn about the natural environment (air, water, soil) and the circulation of matter in the environment. In addition, you will be able to explain the role of environmental analysis in environmental issues and understand the principles of environmental measurement technology.
advice: To understand environmental issues, such as pollution, that significantly affect the global environment, an understanding of the natural environment (air, water, soil) and the circulation of substances through it are necessary. In this course, you will learn about the natural environment, material circulation, and environmental issues. You will also learn the principles and application of measurement methods used for environmental analyses, especially water quality measurements.
books: Textbooks: Chikyu no Kagaku to Kankyou (Sankyo Shuppan Publishing) Reference books: Kankyo Kagaku (Shokabou Publishing), Mizu no Bunseki (Kagaku Dojin Publishing), Kankyo Kagaku Gairon (Maruzen Publishing) Reserved books: Unspecified
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of analytical chemistry is necessary. In addition, knowledge of instrumental analytical chemistry is helpful to understand the principles and applications of environmental analysis methods. Bring a scientific calculator to class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain material circulation in the natural environment (air, water, soil).
Be able to explain the significance of environmental analysis in relation to environmental issues.
Be able to describe water analysis methods.
Be able to understand the principles and characteristics of dating methods.

achievementLevels.ideal: Thoroughly understands the global environment and can explain the application of environmental analysis to environmental issues. In addition, you can explain the principles and methods for environmental analyses.
achievementLevels.standard: Understands the global environment and can explain the application of environmental analysis to environmental issues. In addition, you can explain the principles and methods for environmental analyses.

lessons.content: Course outline Geology, minerals, and plate tectonics
lessons.assignments: Review: Understand the secondary changes in plate tectonics and crustal material.

lessons.content: Natural environment (air, water, soil) Laws on environmental conservation
lessons.assignments: Preview: Examine law on environmental conservation. Review: Environmental quality standards.
Preview: Study the composition of the atmosphere. Review: Material circulation in the atmosphere.

lessons.content: Material circulation in soil and the hydrosphere
lessons.assignments: Preview: Study the structure and function of soil, and the circulation of water. Review: Representative composition in the hydrosphere.

lessons.content: Air pollution, soil pollution, and water pollution
lessons.assignments: Preview: Understand the content in chapters 1 to 4. Review: Each type of pollution.

lessons.content: Outline of water analysis methods and the significance of water quality measurements
lessons.assignments: Preview: Study various analytical methods. Review: Water analysis methods and the significance of water quality measurements.

lessons.content: Analysis of water (1): Volumetric analysis (neutralization titration and chelate titration)
lessons.assignments: Preview: Understand acid-base reactions and chelate formation. Review: Volumetric analysis based on acid-base reactions and chelate formation.

lessons.content: Analysis of water (1): Volumetric analysis (redox titration)
lessons.assignments: Preview: Understand redox reactions. Review: Volumetric analysis based on redox reactions.
Preview: Understand the content in chapters 5 to 8. Review: The principles and characteristics of spectrophotometry.
Preview: Understand redox potential. Review: The principles and characteristics of electrochemical analysis.
Preview: Study chromatography. Review: Various chromatographic methods.
Preview: Understand the content in chapters 9 to 11. Review: Radionuclides and their decay.

lessons.content: Dating method (2): Dating methods using disintegration of primary natural radionuclides and 14C.
lessons.assignments: Preview: Understand primary natural radionuclides. Review: The carbon-14 dating method.
Identify your mistakes and review your weaknesses.
